title: Software Developer
description: Design, build and maintain reliable software by combining programming fundamentals, problem solving and collaborative engineering practices.
summary: Build the foundations of real-world software engineering.

skills.why: Core reasoning skill used to select efficient solutions.
A practical language for application development.
Useful for scripting, automation and quick prototypes.
Essential for version control and team collaboration.
Most applications need structured data access.
Introduces APIs and server-side development.
Turns product requirements into workable solutions.
Makes technical decisions understandable to a team.
Software is commonly built in shared codebases.

roadmap.title: Programming fundamentals
roadmap.detail: Practice variables, control flow, functions, arrays and debugging.

roadmap.title: Data structures and algorithms
roadmap.detail: Work through arrays, strings, maps, stacks, queues and complexity.

roadmap.title: Git and collaborative workflow
roadmap.detail: Use branches, pull requests, reviews and meaningful commits.

roadmap.title: Databases and APIs
roadmap.detail: Model relational data and expose it through a REST API.

roadmap.title: Build and ship a complete application
roadmap.detail: Create a tested product, document decisions and deploy a working version.

projects.title: Personal task manager

projects.title: REST API and database

title: Web Developer
description: Create fast, accessible and responsive websites and web applications across the frontend and backend.
summary: Turn interfaces into complete, useful web experiences.

skills.why: Semantic structure is the base of accessible web pages.
Responsive layout and visual polish are daily work.
The core language of browser interactivity.
A commonly used component-based UI library.
Connects interfaces to server-side logic and APIs.
Supports persistent application data.
Keeps project history and collaboration organized.
Helps clarify requirements and share progress.
Helps diagnose bugs and handle edge cases.

roadmap.title: HTML and accessible structure
roadmap.detail: Build semantic pages, forms, navigation and accessible document structure.

roadmap.title: CSS, layout and responsive design
roadmap.detail: Practice Flexbox, Grid, typography, tokens and mobile-first layouts.

roadmap.title: JavaScript and browser APIs
roadmap.detail: Build interactive interfaces with events, modules, storage and async code.

roadmap.title: Components, APIs and data
roadmap.detail: Learn React concepts, HTTP, REST APIs and database basics.

roadmap.title: Ship a production-style portfolio project
roadmap.detail: Add validation, accessibility checks, testing, documentation and deployment.

projects.title: Portfolio with case studies
projects.description: Present two projects with clear problem statements, decisions and outcomes.

projects.title: Weather and air-quality dashboard
projects.description: Build a responsive dashboard that consumes a public API and handles loading states.

projects.title: Full-stack community board
projects.description: Create a role-aware application with posts, search, validation and persistence.

title: Data Analyst
description: Transform raw information into trustworthy insights through data cleaning, statistical thinking, SQL and clear visual communication.
summary: Find the signal, explain the story, guide the decision.

skills.why: A practical tool for inspection and quick analysis.
Retrieves and shapes data from relational systems.
Supports repeatable analysis and automation.
A common toolkit for data cleaning and transformation.
Helps distinguish patterns from random variation.
Turns analysis into understandable evidence.
Insights matter when stakeholders can act on them.
Challenges assumptions and data quality.

roadmap.title: Spreadsheet analysis
roadmap.detail: Clean data, use formulas, pivot tables and audit assumptions.

roadmap.title: Statistics for decision making
roadmap.detail: Study distributions, sampling, confidence and correlation.

roadmap.title: SQL for analytics
roadmap.detail: Practice joins, aggregations, CTEs and window functions.

roadmap.title: Python data workflow
roadmap.detail: Use notebooks and Pandas to clean, reshape and validate datasets.

roadmap.title: Insight-led reporting
roadmap.detail: Build a visual story, document caveats and present recommendations.

projects.title: Student performance explorer
projects.description: Explore grade distributions and identify patterns without overstating causality.

projects.title: Retail sales analysis
projects.description: Use SQL and Pandas to find seasonality, segments and revenue drivers.

projects.title: Executive insight report
projects.description: Deliver a reproducible analysis and concise stakeholder presentation.

title: Cybersecurity Associate
description: Support secure systems by understanding networks, operating systems, security fundamentals and practical defensive testing.
summary: Understand systems, reduce risk and build safer software.

skills.why: Security work depends on understanding how systems communicate.
Many security and infrastructure tools run on Linux.
Establishes core concepts of risk and protection.
Introduces common web application security risks.
Helps automate repetitive analysis tasks.
Tracks scripts, notes and configuration changes.
Supports disciplined investigation and triage.
Clear incident notes and escalation matter.

roadmap.title: Networking essentials
roadmap.detail: Learn TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, ports, routing and packet flow.

roadmap.title: Linux and command line
roadmap.detail: Navigate files, permissions, processes and logs safely.

roadmap.title: Security fundamentals
roadmap.detail: Study access control, threat modeling, cryptography concepts and risk.

roadmap.title: Web security basics
roadmap.detail: Learn common application risks and defensive controls in a legal lab.

roadmap.title: Document a defensive lab
roadmap.detail: Build a safe lab, automate a small check and communicate findings.

projects.title: Home network map
projects.description: Document a small home lab, network segments and exposed services.

projects.title: Security headers checker
projects.description: Create a defensive tool that reports missing HTTP security headers on owned sites.

projects.title: Incident response playbook
projects.description: Write a practical triage workflow with evidence handling and escalation steps.
